plugin.note: Use dragonfire protection for adult and brutal Blue dragons. Fast tasks cannon baby blue dragons in Taverley Dungeon; adults give slightly more profit, brutal blue dragons add magic and long-ranged dragonfire, and Vorkath is the maximum-profit Dragon Slayer II option with a dedicated boss strategy.

requirements: Partial completion of Dragon Slayer I
Dragonfire protection for adult Blue dragons, Brutal blue dragons, and Vorkath
Dusty key or 70 Agility for Taverley Dungeon access
Dragon Slayer II for Corsair Cove Dungeon and Vorkath
Heroes' Quest for Heroes' Guild basement
The Heart of Darkness for Ruins of Tapoyauik
Charged Pendant of ates for fast Ruins of Tapoyauik access
mechanics: Blue dragons attack with melee and dragonfire.
Brutal blue dragons also attack with magic and use long-ranged dragonfire.
Baby blue dragons do not use dragonfire.
Blue dragons are large and can usually be safespotted with ranged, magic, or halberd-like weapons.
Blue dragons are dragons, so dragonbane weapons apply.
Vorkath counts as a Blue dragon task option but should follow the dedicated Vorkath strategy.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Choose fast baby dragon cannoning, adult dragon profit, brutal blue dragon profit, or Vorkath based on access and task source.
recommendedFor: choosing speed, profit, or Konar handling
requiredOrKeyItems: Ranged, magic, or halberd-like safespot weapon
steps: Confirm the task was assigned after starting Dragon Slayer I.
Use dragonfire protection when fighting adults, brutals, or Vorkath.
Use dragonbane weapons where available.
Use safespots with ranged, magic, or halberd-like weapons when avoiding damage.
Choose Taverley baby blue dragons for speed, adult dragons for modest profit, and Vorkath for maximum profit after Dragon Slayer II.
notes: Most Blue dragon locations have quest, key, or Agility requirements.
Baby blue dragons are faster but drop only baby dragon bones.

methods.label: Taverley baby cannon
methods.summary: Use a dwarf multicannon against baby blue dragons in the main Taverley Dungeon for the fastest general task completion.
recommendedFor: players with dusty key or 70 Agility
steps: Enter Taverley Dungeon with a dusty key or the 70 Agility shortcut.
Use the main dungeon, not the task-only upper area, because the main dungeon has baby blue dragons.
Place a dwarf multicannon where it can hit baby blue dragons.
Bank with Ring of dueling to Castle Wars and return by balloon after Enlightened Journey if desired.
notes: The task-only Taverley upper level is full of adult Blue dragons, making it worse for fast baby-dragon cannoning.

methods.label: Adult blue dragons
methods.summary: Kill adult Blue dragons when dragon bones and blue dragonhide profit are preferred over fastest completion.
recommendedFor: Corsair Cove, Dragon Nest, Taverley, Heroes' Guild, Isle of Souls, or Ogre Enclave access
steps: Use adult Blue dragons when profit matters more than speed.
Keep dragonfire protection active.
Use safespots where available.
Use cannonable locations such as Taverley, Corsair Cove, Dragon Nest, Heroes' Guild, Isle of Souls, or Ogre Enclave when the assignment allows it.
notes: Corsair Cove requires Dragon Slayer II.
Ogre Enclave requires Watchtower and is inefficient for Konar.

methods.label: Brutal blue dragons
methods.summary: Kill Brutal blue dragons for higher-profit blue dragon kills, accepting no-cannon locations and magic pressure.
requiredOrKeyItems: Anti-magic or Protect from Magic handling
The Heart of Darkness for Ruins of Tapoyauik
steps: Use Catacombs of Kourend or Ruins of Tapoyauik for Brutal blue dragons.
Account for the additional magic attack and long-ranged dragonfire.
Use dragonfire protection and ranged dragonbane gear.
Safespot where practical.
Skip Konar assignments to Catacombs or Ruins if speed matters because cannon use is prevented.
notes: Catacombs Brutal blue dragons can drop ancient shards and Dark totem parts.
Ruins of Tapoyauik requires The Heart of Darkness.

methods.label: Konar location handling
methods.summary: Accept Isle of Souls Dungeon, but skip Ogre Enclave, Catacombs of Kourend, and Ruins of Tapoyauik when Konar assigns them.
requiredOrKeyItems: Dwarf multicannon for Isle of Souls Dungeon
steps: Skip Ogre Enclave, Catacombs of Kourend, and Ruins of Tapoyauik when speed matters.
Skip Ogre Enclave because the dragons are very far apart.
Skip Catacombs of Kourend and Ruins of Tapoyauik because they prevent cannon use.
Accept Isle of Souls Dungeon if desired because a cannon can be placed there.
Remember Isle of Souls Dungeon mixes adult and baby blue dragons in the same room.
notes: This follows the task page's specific Konar guidance.

methods.label: Vorkath profit
methods.summary: Use Vorkath after Dragon Slayer II for maximum Blue dragons task profit.
recommendedFor: players with Dragon Slayer II complete
requiredOrKeyItems: Dragon hunter crossbow or other Vorkath gear
steps: Complete Dragon Slayer II to unlock repeatable Vorkath.
Use the dedicated Vorkath strategy rather than the generic Blue dragons methods.
Treat Vorkath as slower but substantially more profitable than regular Blue dragon kills.
notes: See Vorkath/Strategies for the full boss method.
The task page describes Vorkath as the maximum-profit Blue dragons option.

styleOptions.label: Ranged dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Use ranged dragonbane for safe adult, brutal, and Vorkath-style Blue dragon kills.

styleOptions.label: Melee dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Use melee dragonbane for direct adult Blue dragon kills where ranged is not preferred.

styleOptions.label: Magic dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Use magic from safespots or with dragonbane magic gear when desired.
